1. **Title Bar**: At the top, there is a title bar labeled "CHANGE DAY & LOCATION" with a close button (X) on the right side to exit this screen.

2. **Date Selection**: Below the title bar, there is a date selection field with a calendar icon and the placeholder text "Today," indicating that the user can select a specific date.
